description: Draft the verified-finding comment for a maintainer-only repo (modelcontextprotocol/inspector, modelcontextprotocol/servers): outside PRs are closed on sight there, so the contribution that lands is a detailed, verified issue comment. Assembles the comment from your notes: claim, environment, reproduction steps, observed vs expected, root cause, fix sketch, and a verification footer. Sections you leave empty render as explicit gaps, never plausible filler. DRAFT ONLY: nothing is posted, ever. Copy the markdown into the issue thread yourself.

fix.description: Proposed fix sketch, not a code dump.

observed.description: What was observed when the repro ran.

reproduction.description: Reproduction steps, one per line, exact commands.

root_cause.description: Root cause with file paths and line refs when known; empty renders 'not yet isolated'.

name: verify_comment
